blocks.p: Merrivoss Bioanalysis is pleased to provide this proposal. Matrix, species and analytical limits are stated for each assay before any interpretation. This document responds to the request from Avernelwick Pharma for work on 40 compounds from the Avernelwick aminopyrimidine regioisomer test article set.
Reference: MV-2018-052. Prepared by Dr M. Larkin, DMPK Study Director.
40 compounds, supplied by Avernelwick Pharma as 10 mM DMSO solutions (minimum 40 µL each) in a single accession lot.

list: Microsomal CLint: human and rat liver microsomes, 1 µM, five time points
fu,p by equilibrium dialysis: human plasma, rapid equilibrium dialysis with recovery

blocks.p: Methods follow our standard procedures, summarised below. Any deviation is agreed with the client before testing.

Test articles (1 µM) were incubated with pooled human and rat liver microsomes (0.5 mg/mL protein) and NADPH at 37 °C. Samples at 0, 5, 15, 30 and 45 minutes were quenched in acetonitrile with internal standard and analysed by LC-MS/MS. Intrinsic clearance was calculated from the first-order depletion rate; half-lives above 60 minutes are reported as >60.
Matrix acceptance: verapamil (high clearance) and diltiazem (moderate clearance) within historical range in each run.

Binding to human plasma was measured by rapid equilibrium dialysis (5 µM test article, 4 h at 37 °C, PBS pH 7.4). Plasma and buffer compartments were matrix-matched before LC-MS/MS. Fraction unbound (fu) is reported with mass-balance recovery; recoveries below 70% are footnoted.
Warfarin was included as the binding control in every plate.

list: Results workbook (assay worksheets with compound-level data and a study summary sheet)
Final report (PDF) with methods, control results and interpretation
Raw traces and instrument files on request

blocks.p: Draft results within 5 weeks of receipt of test articles. Work starts once compounds and a purchase order are received; we will confirm the start date on receipt.

list: Quotation valid for 90 days from the date above
Invoiced in full on issue of the final report; payment within 30 days
Unused compound returned or destroyed at the client's instruction
Data and samples retained for 5 years
